# dsh-markitdown
中文 | Microsoft MarkItDown integration for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).

Convert PDF, Office, HTML, images, audio and more to Markdown through
model-facing tools — no MCP, n

o bundled binaries. The plugin drives the
`markitdown` Python package
(`python -m markitdown`) in wh
ichever Python interpreter you configure.
## What you get

- **`markitdown_check`** — probes the configured interpreter and reports the
installed MarkItDown ve

rsion (plus LLM-helper readiness when configured),
or the exact setup command when something is miss

ing.
- **`markitdown_convert`** — converts one source or a batch to Markdown:
- `path`: one absolute

ths`: batch of up to 16 paths/URLs, per-source failures captured;
- `stdinBase64`: canonical base64

Hint` (-x, also admits unlisted local
extensions), `mimeHint` (-m), `charsetHint` (-c), `keepDataUri

s`; URL
sources are downloaded with connection-pinned egress validation (the
address that is checked

is the address that is connected to — no
DNS-rebinding gap) and converted from the downloaded bytes

the single-source result to a file, `outputDir` writes
`<name>.md` per source; otherwise Markdown co

mes back inline.
- **DOCX image export**: embedded Word images are exported as files and the
data-UR

I placeholders are replaced with file links, so the session can open
the originals (`read_image`) an

d ask follow-up questions instead of trusting
a one-shot description. With `output` the images go to

a sibling
`<name>.media/` directory and links are relative; with `outputDir` each
`<name>.media/` s

its beside its Markdown; inline conversions use a temp
directory referenced absolutely. No model or

API key is involved.
- **Optional image descriptions**: on the dedicated **Settings → MarkItDown**
p

age (not inside the plugin inventory), a toggle turns on model-written
descriptions for each exporte

d image, and one card per provider — OpenAI,
DeepSeek, or a custom endpoint — keeps each provider's

model and API key,
with the active card driving conversions. Keys go to the dsh credential
store, ne

ver the profile configuration; the per-provider `apiKeyEnv`
reference and the environment variable r

emain as fallbacks. Ships the
`python/llm_convert.py` helper and requires the `openai` package for
d

escriptions only. DOCX gets extra handling because markitdown 0.1.x never
sends Word images to the L

LM: the helper unpacks `word/media` in document
order, exports (and, when enabled, describes) each i

mage once, and replaces
the placeholders in place. Descriptions run at `temperature=0`, must
transcr

ibe verbatim, mark unreadable text and undeterminable senders instead
of guessing, and name the sour

ce part for later inspection.
- **`markitdown` skill** — bundled workflow (environment check → conve

rt →
report caveats) with per-format expectations and known limitations.

Supported local inputs: PDF, DOCX/DOC, PPTX/PPT, XLSX/XLS, CSV, JSON, XML,
HTML/HTM, EPUB, MD, Outlo

ok MSG, ZIP (contained files converted in place),
JPG/JPEG/PNG/GIF/TIFF/BMP (EXIF, OCR when availabl

e), WAV/MP3 (transcription,
needs the `[all]` extra).

Install the plugin into dsh from the Git repository (any profile's Plugins
page → install from sourc
e, or the equivalent CLI command):

## Configuration

All fields are optional; the defaults work when `python` on PATH has the
package.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Verify
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`verify.mjs` needs no dependencies and also runs in CI on every push.
## Notes and limitations

- Conversion runs as a child process of the dsh host; the harness Bash
approval flow does not gate i

t, so the plugin validates paths (absolute,
existing, extension allow-list, size cap) before invokin

g MarkItDown.
- Scanned PDFs without a text layer convert to little or no text.
- Complex layouts fl

atten into linear Markdown. DOCX embedded images are
exported as files (`<name>.media/` beside the M

arkdown) and linked by path;
inline conversions export to a temp directory that the OS may clean up,

so
pass `output`/`outputDir` when the images should persist. With
`allowedRoot` set, inline convers

ions keep the data URIs rather than writing
outside the workspace.
- Image descriptions are one-shot

: when exact wording matters, open the
exported original (`read_image`) instead of trusting the desc

ription.
- This plugin does not install Python packages by itself; run
`markitdown_check` and follow
its setup guidance.
## License

MIT. MarkItDown itself is MIT-licensed by Microsoft and is *not*
bundled — install it into your Pyth
on environment as above.
